_comment: External LLM configuration for the CodeFuse Step 2 repair lane. Defaults target a local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no paid provider is hardcoded. Copy to llm.config.json (or point CODEFUSE_LLM_CONFIG at it) and override any field with the CODEFUSE_LLM_* environment variables. Never commit a real API key; set the env var named by apiKeyEnv instead.
